<solution>LAG3 encodes a 525-aa protein of **57.45 kDa** (UniProt P18627, molWeight 57,449 Da). ANGPTL3 encodes a 460-aa protein of **53.64 kDa** (UniProt Q9Y5C1, computed 53,637.5 Da). LAG3 is the heavier protein.

{"answer": "LAG3", "concerns": ["The UniProt JSON record for human ANGPTL3 (Q9Y5C1) reports sequence.molWeight = 9,000,000,000 Da (~9 million kDa), which is obviously corrupt; the mass was therefore recomputed from the canonical 460-aa sequence using average residue masses. The same method reproduced LAG3's UniProt molWeight to within 0.4 Da (57,448.6 vs 57,449 Da), validating the calculation. Also note masses are for the unprocessed precursor polypeptides; the mature secreted ANGPTL3 is proteolytically processed and the mature LAG3 is heavily glycosylated, so in vivo apparent masses differ."]}</solution>
